lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank. Blobs exhibit a size-gradient, being larger and more widely spaced in the center-flank and smaller/denser towards the dorsal and anterior regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot-rows to form a faint, grid-like network, particularly visible posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition along the horizontal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal teleost fish (likely Remoras) visible as distinct high-contrast silhouettes near the ventral-posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
